description: READ ONLY. Explains a USPS tracking status ("Notice Left", "Available for Pickup", "Unclaimed", "Refused", "Return to Sender", "Insufficient Address", "Delivered, Left with Individual"...) or a Piloxa transaction state (AWAITING_APPROVAL, VENDOR_ACCEPTED, MAILED, DELIVERED...) in plain words, with the likely next step and the guide that explains it. It explains the status in general; for a specific letter prepared in this conversation use get_certified_letter_status. It never says whether a notice is legally effective.

status.description: The status text exactly as shown, e.g. "Notice Left (No Authorized Recipient Available)".

name: explain_certified_mail_status
title: Explain a Certified Mail status
